enchantments.tooltip: Fire Shield (Cold): When you are successfully attacked, there is a 10% chance that a Fire Shield (Cold) will be cast on you. If this effect activates while you have an active Fire Shield (Hot) from another item source, they will nullify each-other.
Fire Absorption +20%: Passive: 20% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fire Resistance +30: Passive: +30 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Resistance +4: Passive: +4 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Lesser Regeneration: This item is imbued with an undeniable goodness that slowly heals the wearer over time.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
